name: Water Pouch Bounty
summary: In Gadgetzan, Spigot Operator Luglunket welcomes you back for five more Wastewander water pouches. A care package waits with your name on it.

sections.title: Back Again
sections.body: Luglunket welcomes you back and asks for five more Wastewander water pouches. A care package is already set aside with your name on it.

sections.title: Keep Them Coming
sections.body: Luglunket is pleased with the reclaimed pouches. Each one keeps everyone further from disaster. Luglunket promises to make it worth your while for every five you bring.

faq.answer: Luglunket, the spigot operator in Gadgetzan, offers the bounty.

faq.q: How many water pouches are needed?
faq.answer: You need five Wastewander water pouches, the same number as before.
Luglunket has a care package set aside under your name.
This follows the earlier Water Pouch Bounty, when you first brought pouches to Luglunket.
